rapport_notes: Calm and patient through a lot of confused/incorrect address and storage-unit details, professional but not especially warm.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern raised beyond logistics/address confusion.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated then of course you pay less

top_strength: Patiently untangled a confusing, disorganized set of move details (wrong address on file, split storage units, partial DIY move) without losing track or frustrating the customer.
coaching_note: No quid pro quo time-box was given up front -- establishing "this'll take about X minutes, then I'll give you an accurate quote" early might have kept this scattered, detail-heavy call more structured.
